title: Best of Bhutan | Thimphu Tshechu Festival & Cultural Highlights
highlights: Discover the best of Bhutan with a journey specially planned around the Thimphu Tshechu Festival (21st–23rd September 2026), aloong with mountain landscapes and cultural landmarks.
Stay in comfortable hotels across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, and Paro at an unbeatable price, offering a convenient base to explore Bhutan's cultural and natural wonders.
Experience Bhutan's iconic highlights, including the Tiger's Nest Monastery, Punakha Dzong, Dochula Pass, Chele La Pass, and the country's charming capital cities.
Witness the Thimphu Tshechu Festival, where centuries-old masked cham dances, traditional music, & vibrant cultural performances bring Bhutan's rich heritage to life.
Enjoy seamless travel with all major transfers, including airport, intercity, and sightseeing transfers, ensuring a smooth & hassle-free journey throughout.
overview:
About the tour:
Experience the timeless charm of Bhutan on this immersive journey through its serene valleys, ancient monasteries, and vibrant cultural traditions. Begin in the peaceful border town of Phuentsholing before travelling to Thimphu, where spirituality and heritage come alive through sacred monasteries, traditional arts, and local landmarks. Journey across the breathtaking Dochula Pass to explore the magnificent Punakha Dzong and the iconic Punakha Suspension Bridge. Witness the colourful Thimphu Tshechu Festival, one of Bhutan's most celebrated cultural events, featuring sacred masked dances and centuries-old traditions. Hike to the legendary Tiger's Nest Monastery, dramatically perched on a cliff overlooking Paro Valley, for an unforgettable spiritual and scenic experience. Complete your adventure with panoramic Himalayan views from Chele La Pass and leisurely exploration of Phuentsholing. Blending breathtaking landscapes, rich Buddhist heritage, and authentic cultural experiences, this tour offers the perfect introduction to the Land of the Thunder Dragon.
inclusions: 2 nights stay in Phuntsholing with breakfast and lunch or dinner
2 nights stay in Thimphu City with breakfast
2 nights stay in Paro with breakfast and lunch or dinner
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Ask your local guide to help you purchase a SIM on arrival, as Bhutan supports 2 networks: B-Mobile SIM and TashiCell.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
Images are for representation purpose only.

Indians must pay the Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) of Rs 1200 per person/per night. Children below 5 years are exempted from SDF, while kids between 6 and 12 years of age, will get 50% concession.
To obtain entry in Bhutan, Indian tourists must carry their passports with a minimum 6 months validity and make the payment of SDF.
Plastic has been banned since 1999 in Bhutan, therefore, it is advised to carry plastic/plastic items.
Keep your arms and legs covered while visiting a Dzong (fortress-monastery).
Ask for permission from the attending authority before taking any photos or videos inside places like monasteries.
In Bhutan, Tuesday is ‘Dry Day’. This means locals don’t drink alcohol on Tuesday. So it would be respectful to avoid alcohol on Tuesdays too.
It’s illegal for tobacco to be sold in Bhutan. Tourists can bring cigarettes into the country, but can only smoke them in designated places.
Bhutan does not have a micro (or nano) SIM card. So check your mobile device for SIM compatibility before visiting Bhutan.
Credit cards are widely accepted in major cities and tourist areas. However, it is recommended to carry some cash.
The official currency in Bhutan is the Bhutanese Ngultrum (BTN). It is advisable to exchange currency at banks or authorised exchange bureaus.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.
Travellers aren't expected to wear the traditional kira, but you should make sure your clothing covers your arms and legs when entering a Dzong.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Siliguri | Transfer to Phuntsholing | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome to Siliguri! Upon arrival, board your transfer to Phuentsholing, the charming gateway to Bhutan. Once you reach, check-in to your hotel & relax for the day. You can also head out to visit the iconic Bhutan Gate, a striking symbol of traditional Bhutanese architecture, followed by the Zangto Pelri Lhakhang, renowned for its intricate murals dedicated to Guru Rinpoche. You can also explore Gumpha Mandir or head to Alapan View Point to admire panoramic views of the surrounding landscapes.

days.title: Transfer to Thimphu | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: After checking out, visit the immigration office to complete the permit formalities before beginning your scenic drive to Thimphu, Bhutan's charming capital. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for the day. You may visit the historic Dechen Phodrang Monastery for a glimpse into Bhutan's rich spiritual heritage or explore the National Institute to learn about the country's traditional arts and crafts. Also, you can enjoy a stroll through the Royal Botanical Garden.

days.title: Day Trip to Punakha
days.desc: Today, set out on an excursion to Punakha via the Dochula Pass, known for its 108 memorial chortens & Himalayan views. Visit the Chimi Lhakhang, also known as the Fertility Temple, famous for its unique wooden phallus symbols & traditions. Continue to the Punakha Dzong, one of Bhutan's most beautiful fortresses, before walking across the iconic Punakha Suspension Bridge, offering views of the Pho Chu River. Also, you can opt for a white-water rafting experience on the Pho Chu or Mo Chu River.

items.title: River Rafting at the Pho Chu and Mo Chu River
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour with Thimphu Tshechu Festival | Transfer to Paro
days.desc: Check-out & begin your day with a sightseeing tour of Thimphu. Visit the National Memorial Chorten, the sacred Changangkha Lhakhang, & the Motithang Takin Preserve, home to Bhutan's unique national animal. Continue to the Tashichho Dzong, a fortress-monastery & witness the vibrant Thimphu Tshechu Festival, where monks & performers dressed in costumes present traditional masked cham dances, offering a glimpse into Bhutan's rich culture. Afterwards, get driven to Paro & check in to your hotel.

days.title: Hike to Tiger’s Nest Monastery
days.desc: Begin your day with a drive to Satsam Chorten, the starting point of the legendary Tiger's Nest Monastery (Paro Taktsang) trek. Once there, begin your hike through pine forests adorned with colourful prayer flags while enjoying views of Bhutan's most iconic monastery. Upon reaching the monastery, explore its sacred temples, ancient murals, and meditation caves associated with Guru Rinpoche. After descending, get driven back to your hotel.

items.title: Dine-in at the PARK 76 Cafe & Pub
items.label: Suggestion

days.title: Transfer to Phuntsholing | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Check-out and begin your scenic drive to Phuentsholing. En route, cross the Chele La Pass, the highest motorable pass in Bhutan, where you can admire views of the Himalayan peaks, alpine forests, and colourful prayer flags fluttering in the mountain breeze. Upon arrival in Phuentsholing, check in to your hotel & you may visit the Amo Chhu Crocodile Breeding Centre to observe endangered gharials and mugger crocodiles or stroll through the Phuentsholing Market to shop for local handicrafts.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, board your transfer to New Jalpaiguri Railway Station or Bagdogra Airport for your onward journey. As your memorable Bhutan holiday comes to an end, take back unforgettable memories of serene monasteries, majestic Himalayan landscapes, vibrant festivals, and the warm hospitality of the Land of the Thunder Dragon.
